description: For pest control, this inspection checklist records inspection, treatment sites, product and method, label restrictions, preparation, reentry, exclusions, and follow-up. Its supporting evidence includes activity observations, conducive conditions, monitoring results, product lot and amount, placement map, and photos.

items: Target activity and treated or monitored locations are reconciled
Product, method, lot, amount, and placement are recorded
Label preparation, exclusion, ventilation, and reentry controls are met
Children, animals, food, water, and sensitive areas are protected
Conducive conditions and recommended corrections are documented
Monitoring result, customer notice, and follow-up date are set

subtitle: Pest Control Inspection Checklist: residential pest-control service and treatment record using target pest, inspection, and activity observations.
title: Pest Control Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential pest-control service and treatment record when the pest control record must identify target pest, structures, rooms, exterior zones, occupants, children, animals, sensitivities, and prior activity. Complete the applicable handoff for treatment record, safety instructions, reentry acknowledgment, monitoring plan, corrective recommendations, and follow-up.
